steps.text: Cash break on income account QNT-009-INC (USD): IBOR USD 271,784.19 vs custodian USD 365,689.83. Income cash only moves on dividends and coupons, so I'll look for entries that exist on one side only.
income cash balance on both books
Confirmed: custodian is above IBOR by USD 93,905.64. Looking for entries that only one book has.
cash entries on one side only
2 one-sided entries totalling USD -93,905.64 against a break of USD -93,905.64.
Conclusion: missed corporate action, 90% confidence. Owner: Corporate Actions.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  b.break_id,
  b.as_of,
  b.account_id,
  b.security_id,
  s.ticker,
  s.isin,
  s.currency AS sec_ccy,
  s.country,
  b.currency,
  b.break_type,
  b.ibor_value,
  b.custodian_value,
  b.difference,
  b.difference_usd,
  b.status
FROM breaks AS b
LEFT JOIN securities AS s
  ON s.security_id = b.security_id
WHERE
  b.break_id = 'BRK-0162'
LIMIT 200

queries.purpose: income cash balance on both books
queries.sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    'IBOR' AS book,
    balance
  FROM ibor_cash_balances
  WHERE
    account_id = 'QNT-009-INC' AND currency = 'USD'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'CUSTODIAN' AS book,
    balance
  FROM custodian_cash_balances
  WHERE
    account_id = 'QNT-009-INC' AND currency = 'USD'
) AS u
LIMIT 200

queries.purpose: cash entries on one side only
queries.sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM (
  SELECT
    c.entry_id,
    c.value_date,
    c.entry_type,
    c.amount,
    c.reference,
    'CUSTODIAN_ONLY' AS side
  FROM custodian_cash_activity AS c
  LEFT JOIN ibor_cash_activity AS i
    ON i.account_id = c.account_id AND i.reference = c.reference
  WHERE
    c.account_id = 'QNT-009-INC'
    AND c.currency = 'USD'
    AND c.value_date >= '2026-11-05'
    AND i.entry_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    i.entry_id,
    i.value_date,
    i.entry_type,
    i.amount,
    i.reference,
    'IBOR_ONLY' AS side
  FROM ibor_cash_activity AS i
  LEFT JOIN custodian_cash_activity AS c
    ON c.account_id = i.account_id AND c.reference = i.reference
  WHERE
    i.account_id = 'QNT-009-INC'
    AND i.currency = 'USD'
    AND i.value_date >= '2026-11-05'
    AND c.entry_id IS NULL
) AS u
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  ca.ca_id,
  ca.ca_type,
  s.ticker,
  ca.ex_date,
  ca.record_date,
  ca.pay_date,
  ca.rate,
  ca.currency,
  p.ibor_status,
  cp.cash_amount AS cust_cash
FROM corporate_actions AS ca
JOIN securities AS s
  ON s.security_id = ca.security_id
LEFT JOIN ca_processing AS p
  ON p.ca_id = ca.ca_id AND p.account_id = 'QNT-009'
LEFT JOIN custodian_ca_postings AS cp
  ON cp.ca_id = ca.ca_id AND cp.account_id = 'QNT-009'
WHERE
  ca.ca_id IN ('CA7756', 'CA7792')
LIMIT 200

finding.summary: Missed corporate action. Custodian credited 2 dividends IBOR never booked [Q3:r0, Q3:r1]: NFLX CA7756 paid 2026-11-13 (USD 78,221.16, IBOR NOT_PROCESSED), DIS CA7792 paid 2026-11-19 (USD 15,684.48, IBOR NOT_PROCESSED) [Q4:r0, Q4:r1]. Together they account for the full USD -93,905.64 [Q2:r0, Q2:r1].
finding.proposed_fix: Book the missing dividend income in IBOR for QNT-009: CA7756 USD 78,221.16, CA7792 USD 15,684.48. Check why the CA feed skipped this account.
